First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace

About the Beginner / Casual Ride group ride

Beginner / Casual Ride is a road and social group ride in Atlanta, GA. It rolls second Saturday of the month at 9:00 am from Peters St. U-Haul.

A monthly city-street group ride for people new to riding in a group, with an 18-mile and a 28-mile option toward Hwy 29. The club says no one will be left behind. The calendar also lists a pre-ride at 7:00 am from the same spot.
